title: Water Tank Empty
fullDescription: Cafe espresso machine cannot detect water in tank. Either empty or float sensor stuck.

fixSteps.title: Refill
fixSteps.instruction: Fill tank to MAX line and reseat.

title: Bean Hopper Empty
fullDescription: Grinder runs but no beans falling. Refill hopper or check for jam.

title: Grinder Jam
fullDescription: Foreign object or rock in beans jammed the burr grinder.

title: Drip Tray Full
fullDescription: Sensor detects full drip tray. Empty and reinsert.

fixSteps.title: Empty tray
fixSteps.instruction: Slide out, dump, rinse, reinsert fully.

title: Grounds Bin Full
fullDescription: Internal puck container needs emptying. Pull out, dump pucks, reinsert.

title: Descale Required
fullDescription: Internal scale counter triggered descaling reminder. Run descaling cycle with approved solution.

fixSteps.title: Run descale
fixSteps.instruction: Use Cafe descaler per manual cycle.

title: Brew Unit Missing
fullDescription: Brew group not seated correctly after cleaning. Reinsert until it clicks.

fixSteps.title: Reseat
fixSteps.instruction: Push brew unit until firm click.

title: Heating System Fault
fullDescription: Thermoblock failed to heat. Possible heating element or thermostat fault.

title: Pump Failure
fullDescription: Pump cannot achieve brew pressure. Air lock or pump failure.

fixSteps.title: Prime pump
fixSteps.instruction: Run hot water/steam dispense to clear air.

title: SmartHQ Connection Lost
fullDescription: Cafe espresso lost WiFi link to SmartHQ. Local brewing still works.

fixSteps.title: Reconnect
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > WiFi > Reconnect via SmartHQ app.

title: Bean Hopper Empty
shortDescription: Bean hopper empty alert on Cafe Affetto.
fullDescription: Affetto sensor detects bean level; brewing disabled below threshold.
videoSearchQuery: GE Cafe Affetto bean hopper alert

faq.a: Any whole roasted beans, avoid extra oily.

title: Milk Reservoir Issue
shortDescription: Milk reservoir not detected for milk drinks.
fullDescription: Cafe Specialty milk reservoir uses magnetic sensor; if not seated or magnet weak, milk drinks fail.
videoSearchQuery: GE Cafe milk reservoir not detected

title: Steam Generator Fault
fullDescription: Cafe machines with milk system use a steam thermoblock; failure prevents milk frothing.
videoSearchQuery: GE Cafe steam generator no steam fix

title: Error E10 Pump Fault
fullDescription: E10 typically indicates pump cannot reach pressure for espresso.

fixSteps.title: Prime
fixSteps.instruction: Run hot water cycle 2x to purge air.

videoSearchQuery: GE Cafe E10 pump fault fix

title: Descale Required
fullDescription: Cafe machines schedule descale based on brew counter and water hardness setting.

fixSteps.title: Run cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Use menu to start cycle (~25 min).

title: Replace Water Filter
shortDescription: Water filter cartridge end of life.
fullDescription: Cafe filter lasts 2 months; alert appears at expiration.

title: Profile Selection Required
shortDescription: User profile required before brewing custom drinks.
fullDescription: Cafe Affetto allows multiple profiles via SmartHQ app; profile must be selected for personalized drinks.

title: Grinder Stalled
shortDescription: Grinder stalled — possible bean jam or motor overload.
fullDescription: Cafe grinders use ceramic burrs; jam from foreign object stalls motor.
videoSearchQuery: GE Cafe grinder stall jam fix

faq.a: Use only roasted whole beans, no flavored or oily.

title: SmartHQ App Disconnected
fullDescription: Cafe machines connect via 2.4GHz Wi-Fi to SmartHQ; disconnects from router or auth issues.

title: Empty Drip Tray
fullDescription: Float sensor detects tray water level; brewing disabled when full.
videoSearchQuery: GE Cafe empty drip tray alert
